thread:
ana: Quick heads-up: PR #3742 updates the OptKit guide to clarify quant recommendations for short-turn chat and adds a tiny 'KV vs prefix' decision row. Need a fast review — small edits only.

todd: scanning now. two quick items: 1) Go snippet uses old `MakePrefetcher()` API, 2) the quant table still shows q4_0 for 'short-turn' cell.

ana: meant to flip that to q4_1. I'll change both.

jing: I can patch the Go snippet to use `prefetch.NewClient()` and run `gofmt` locally. Also noticed the Python snippet lacks the `quant_profile="q4_1"` parameter in the call.

ana: thanks. can you push both fixes to the branch? I want the examples to be consistent across languages.

jing: done. committed two small fixes: Go client update + python snippet param. Also added a one-line sidenote under the prefetch code: "KV prefetch -> repeated KV hits; prefix cache -> prefix completions."

ci-bot: CI: docs-lint failed  linkcheck: /optimize/heuristics 404 in docs/optkit/guide.md:line 98

todd: I moved that anchor last week. the correct anchor is /optimize/heuristics#batching-and-caching. I'll update the link.

ana: updated link and pushed. Added tiny i18n note too.

i18n-bot: Translation note inserted: "Quant default for short-turn chat changed to q4_1; update localized examples."

ci-bot: CI: docs-lint all checks passed on staging. examples formatting OK.

ana: merging PR #3742 now. I'll file a follow-up issue to add formatting checks for examples (gofmt/black/rustfmt) in docs CI.

todd: filing issue would be great — helps avoid regressions.

ci-bot: Deploy: docs-staging -> prod succeeded (2025-03-03 18:22:10 UTC).

jing: nice! can we also add a small console note in release notes that the optkit default changed for short-turn flows? some integrators rely on default profiles.

ana: added an item to the release notes draft and the weekly docs sync agenda. thanks everyone! :tada:
